title: OpenAI Sets $1.4T Valuation for New $30B Fundraise
summary:
Multiple investment funds from the United Arab Emirates are in talks to serve as anchor investors for a new financing round for the creator of ChatGPT. The company is requesting at least $30 billion at a fixed pre-money valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion, skipping the typical negotiation process with a lead investor. BlackRock is also in discussions to participate in the syndicate, with UAE investors potentially contributing up to $10 billion collectively.

The capital raise occurs as OpenAI delays any initial public offering until at least 2027 to prioritize funding for AI infrastructure and development. Other potential participants include Andreessen Horowitz, Thrive Capital, and the endowment for the University of California. Abu Dhabi-based MGX, which has previously invested in both OpenAI and Anthropic, raised nearly $50 billion earlier this year for AI technology investments.

selectedTweets.text:
OPENAI IN TALKS WITH UAE FUNDS, BLACKROCK FOR $30B FUNDING ROUND AT ~$1.4T VALUATION: BBG

OpenAI is in talks with several UAE investment funds, including Abu Dhabi-based MGX, to help anchor a new financing round of at least $30B.

UAE investors have discussed contributing as much as $10B collectively, while BlackRock $BLK is also in discussions to participate alongside the syndicate.

Existing backers Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz have discussed investing, while OpenAI has also held talks with the University of California’s endowment.

The company is presenting investors with a fixed ~$1.4T pre-money valuation rather than negotiating the valuation through a traditional lead-investor process.

The fundraising comes as OpenAI pushes potential IPO plans until at least 2027 while continuing to raise large amounts of capital to fund AI development and infrastructure.

MGX has previously invested in both OpenAI and Anthropic and earlier this year raised nearly $50B to invest across AI infrastructure and technology.

Source: Bloomberg
